title: Connect to a server
excerpt: Connect to a server A client holds one connection to one server: construct a Client, pick a transport , and connect(). Create a client and connect over HTTP Client takes a name and a version; StreamableHTTPClientTransport takes the server's MCP endpoint URL. connect() runs the initialize handshake and resolves once it completes.
